description: Add a new credit card to the household portfolio. Accepts a card name (fuzzy match) or exact card_template_id from search_catalog. If multiple cards match the name, returns candidates to choose from — call again with the confirmed card_template_id. Supports full metadata on creation (last_four, original_open_date, is_business, etc.) so no follow-up update_card call is needed.

card_template_id.description: Exact template ID from search_catalog (bypasses fuzzy match)

counts_toward_524.description: Override default 5/24 inclusion (business cards default to false)

fee_month.description: Month annual fee posts (1-12). Inferred from original_open_date if omitted.

is_business.description: Whether this is a business card (excluded from 5/24 by default)

last_four.description: Last 4 digits of the card number

name.description: Card name to fuzzy match (e.g., 'Amex Gold'). Required unless card_template_id is provided.

nickname.description: Nickname to distinguish duplicate cards (defaults to last_four if omitted)

original_open_date.description: Original card open date (YYYY-MM-DD). Used for 5/24 tracking and fee_month inference.

owner.description: Owner profile name (must match an existing profile, e.g., 'Matt')

product_changed_from.description: Previous card name if this was a product change

name: create_card
